# stalwart_oauth_client (Data Source)

Defines a registered OAuth client application.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Identifier of the object.

### Read-Only

- `client_id` (String) Unique identifier of the OAuth client
- `contacts` (Set of String) Contact email addresses for the OAuth client
- `created_at` (String) Creation date of the OAuth client
- `description` (String) Description of the OAuth client
- `expires_at` (String) Expiration date of the OAuth client
- `logo` (String) URL or base64-encoded image representing the OAuth client
- `member_tenant_id` (String) Identifier for the tenant this OAuth client belongs to
- `redirect_uris` (Set of String) List of redirect URIs for the OAuth client
- `secret` (String, Sensitive) Secret value of the OAuth client
